title_en: 41st Scout Brigade has been sent to rescue a man who was involved in an accident when his motorcycle crashed into the road at Raman Township, Yala Province.

Lady Waraporn Kietnoi, Assistant Chief of Civil Affairs, Task Force 41st Military Division, along with 4115th Military Brigade, provided assistance to people who were involved in accidents while riding motorcycles.
